items.lede: The Android version of Premiere has unique layouts on candy bar phones and foldable devices. It’s free to use and available today.
items.title: Adobe Premiere, One of the iPhone’s Best Video-Editing Apps, Is Now on Android

items.lede: Adobe has released its Premiere editing app for Android, a year after its iOS launch.
items.title: Adobe Premiere mobile is now available on Android

items.lede: You don't even need a Creative Cloud login to edit clips, but AI features cost extra.
items.title: Adobe Premiere finally brings powerful video editing to Android, and it's free
